title: merge-gated finds its manifest from any working folder
evidence: tools/merge-gated.sh takes generated-files.json from beside itself, or ./ when $0 has no slash (sh merge-gated.sh inside tools/); git log pathspecs use :(top) and the diff --no-relative, so a run inside tools/ still matches root paths
durability_check: tools/merge-gated-generated.test.ts T-12 (run inside tools/ refuses a stale row and merges a clean PR; a copy by absolute path reads the manifest beside it)
